serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: Who goes there?!
Landlord: Oh, it’s only you.
You: Hi…
Landlord: What’s that smell?
You: Oh, uh…{{wi}} we are next to the trash bins so it’s probably that.
Landlord: That certainly makes sense, but I didn’t smell anything just a moment ago.
You: …
You: A-anyway, I’m going to throw this out really quick.
